title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP programme in Uganda has two components. A Sustainable Landscapes component that will be implemented in the Kigezi sub-region and specifically in the catchment area surrounding Lake Bunyoni. That programme component will support 4,000 households (24,000 beneficiaries). Communities will be trained in agroforestry, tree planting and management. The programme will facilitate the planting of tress and continued management of forested areas (at least 500 hectares will be under tree coverage). Natural Resource Management Plans will be developed and implemented. Communities will also be trained in Climate Smart Agriculture, diversified farming practices and the establishment of woodlots for fuel wood and other economic purposes. Awareness will be raised of harmful environmental practices. The programme will facilitate co-ordination between government agencies and hotel owners for the establishment of effective waste disposal methods. The capacity of Local Authorities will be built to enable them to influence policies relating to management and protection of the lake catchment area. Green enterprises supported will include eco-tourism, waste management and waste recycling.The second ICSP programme component in Uganda focuses on food systems and will be implemented in the West Nile and Teso sub-regions. It will target 2,000 households (12,000 beneficiaries). Training will be delivered on Climate Smart Agriculture and good Agronomic Practices, block farms will be established and maintained, and farmer groups will be formed. Subsidised agricultural inputs will be provided, seed fairs will be held, and regular field visits conducted by agricultural extension workers. Training will be delivered on value addition, food preservation and agro-processing for selected value chains. Women and youth will be specifically targeted for the establishment of home gardens and trained on safe food handling techniques and improved storage practices. Awareness will be raised in the wider community of good hygiene and sanitation practices. Waste management systems will be put in place to ensure safe disposal of human waste and recycling of agricultural waste for manure and animal fodder. A project in Uganda that promotes livelihoods that enhance climate action and adaptation. Marked 2 for Adaptation.
